about_the_game:
Ellsydia is a small casual management and building game where you create a village in a medieval setting with a touch of fantasy. Construct buildings and shops to attract residents and travelers. Upgrade your buildings and complete various objectives to make your village a vibrant and welcoming place to live! Keep your villagers happy and follow their lives through the many missions that will be offered to you.

Gameplay

Village creation on side scroll view

Build houses, shops, and businesses to grow your village's population with a side view that lets you fully appreciate your buildings and the lives of residents. Customize your buildings to suit your tastes while also taking into account the needs of villagers.

Management of shops and stores

Offer a variety of products and services that you've carefully selected based on the villagers' preferences. Customize recipes for your inns dishes and taverns drinks with the various ingredients at your disposal. Find the right items to sell and set the right prices to satisfy customers.

Follow villagers

Keep an eye on villagers going about their lives and pay attention. Maybe they may occasionally ask you for help. Consider their needs and remember their feedback to make wise choices for improving your village and the residents happyness. And maybe earning some rewards.

Little surprises!

A few Easter eggs and references are scattered throughout Ellsydia. Can you find them?

Features

Whats Ellsydia offer:

  • 3 to 5 hours of gameplay

  • Creation of a fantasy medieval village

  • Buildings and scenery drawing in anime style with a side-scrolling vue

  • Simple shop and store management with recipes customization and selection of items to sell

  • Several challenges and hidden (or not so hidden ;-)) Easter eggs

  • A relaxing and peaceful moment without combat or violence

Ellsydia doesn't have:

  • A large number of missions

  • A multiplayer mode

  • Challenging, extreme, and advanced management

  • Combat and violence

  • The content and richness of a big production

Game modes

The game only offers:

  • A single-player mode in which you must complete the objectives of each level

  • A sandbox mode that allows you to build without constraints.

A quick note from the developer

Hi! I'm David, codename Pixilluzion. I'm the solo and indie developper who design and develop this project. After dedicating several challenging years to making my previous game. I wanted to take a fresh start and offer simpler, and above all, much smaller games. Ellsydia being my first small commercial game, it's important to keep in mind that it won't have the same level of content as a production made by a large team over several years, but it was created with care and passion.

I sincerly hope you'll spend a great and funny moment with Ellsydia.

  • Storage: 300 MB available space

short_description: Welcome to Ellsydia! A haven of peace awaits you to unleash your building skills. In a medieval fantasy setting, construct, customize, and manage your buildings. Make your village prosper and ensure the well-being of its villagers so they feel happy and fulfilled.
